references.text: The curse of Eden is used as an oath, similar to how the woman becomes a curse among her people
Israel will become a curse and a proverb among the nations, parallel to the woman who becomes a curse among her people
The oath of the curse and its physical consequences are parallel to the oath the priest pronounces over the woman
The name is used as a curse formula, similar to how the woman becomes an example of a curse
Zedekiah and Ahab are used as examples of curses, parallel to the woman who becomes a curse among her people
To become a curse and a byword among the nations, the same concept found in the oath formula
Describes the fulfillment of the curse with the same physical symptoms: the thigh falls away and the belly swells
